items.description: Preferred selection with optional actual measurements

tools.description: Get actionable high-confidence low-stock recommendations.
tools.name: get_low_stock_predictions

tools.description: Get one canonical product by its ID or exact name/alias.
tools.name: get_product

tools.description: Add a product to the household grocery list. Omitted unknownProductPolicy uses propose_if_missing: begin uncertain names there and present product_resolution_required candidates or advice without mutation. Use explicit create_if_missing only with complete deterministic product facts. An omitted grocery quantity defaults to 1 only for a new line; confirmation_required never changes an existing quantity.
tools.name: grocery_add

tools.description: Apply a user-approved final product-creation payload and complete the original grocery addition without an LLM call. Do not send proposal state or source. An omitted quantity defaults to 1 only for a new line. confirmation_required means an existing pending quantity was not changed; handle that as a separate user decision. PRODUCT_NAME_CONFLICT is final for this decision and must not be auto-retried.
tools.name: grocery_confirm_new_product

tools.description: Apply a user-approved alias to one exact target product ID and complete the original grocery addition without an LLM call. Do not infer the target, send proposal state, or send source. The alias stays saved if confirmation_required reports an existing pending line; quantity remains a separate user decision. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND and PRODUCT_NAME_CONFLICT are final for this decision and must not be auto-retried.
tools.name: grocery_confirm_product_alias

tools.description: List grocery items, pending by default.
tools.name: grocery_list

tools.description: Remove one grocery-list item by its ID.
tools.name: grocery_remove

tools.description: Set one pending grocery item to an absolute final quantity. Calculate relative requests before calling and copy expectedRequestedQuantity from the latest grocery_list result. GROCERY_ITEM_CHANGED requires a fresh user decision: do not retry or recalculate automatically. Make no call when the chosen final quantity is unchanged.
tools.name: grocery_set_quantity

tools.description: Update unit, note, or intentional combinations of fields on one pending grocery item using expected old values. Prefer grocery_set_quantity for quantity-only changes.
tools.name: grocery_update

tools.description: Read the complete materialized household inventory grouped into current and uncertain products. Depleted and untracked products are omitted.

tools.description: List recorded inventory events newest first. This is history, not an estimate of current stock.
tools.name: list_inventory_events

tools.description: Add a user-confirmed alias to one exact product ID outside a grocery workflow. Resolve ambiguity and obtain explicit confirmation before calling. Do not infer the target, send source, or retry automatically after an uncertain result.
tools.name: product_add_alias
